records.summary: Acode documents plugin display name, stable identifier, versioned ZIP updates, author, license and keywords; the icon is limited to 50 KB. No publication or price activation is implied.
Termux:API provides shell-script access to the system clipboard in a separate Android terminal environment. The clipboard capability is not exclusive to this product.
TerminalCopy names a technical clipboard command for a focused terminal selection. This is lexical overlap, not proof of a registered trademark or equivalent commercial product.
NirCmd uses shellcopy for file copying. The alternative name overlaps with an existing technical command but the functionality differs.
Android robot use requires attribution under the specified Creative Commons license. Logo-derived trademark and broader branding rights remain to be reviewed before commercial release.
